verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud/compute platform, not an AI agent or assistant with its own tool-use runtime — the evidence shows Runpod publishes MCP servers (the server role, docs-3, docs-36, probe-3) and integrates with external coding agents via skills, but there's no first-party agent/chat runtime into which a user would 'plug' external MCP servers for Runpod itself to consume their tools. This client-side capability is a category error for an infrastructure platform rather than an applicable-but-unmet axis.
